title: 第十六章 魍魉暗作祟，轻手破阴私
content_zh:
午后日头渐盛，庭院里的海棠落了满地残红，风一吹，细碎花瓣簌簌落在青石阶上。

    沈清鸢将萧聿辞送来的东宫密名单仔细收好，叠得整整齐齐收进妆匣暗格。有了这份名单，萧景煜暗中蛰伏的所有势力，她便尽数了然于心，再不必被动提防。

    春桃端着冰镇莲子羹进来，眉眼舒展：“小姐，天热，喝点羹汤解暑。如今咱们手握证据、掌着家权，柳氏被禁足，太子被思过，总算能安稳几日了。”

    沈清鸢拿起银匙轻轻搅动羹汤，淡淡摇头：“安稳不了。柳氏在相府扎根十几年，亲信遍布各处，她绝不可能坐以待毙。如今她被禁足封院，明面上动不了我，必定会在暗处搞小动作。”

    话音刚落，院外便隐隐传来细碎的议论声，几个扫地的丫鬟仆婢凑在一起，压低了声音窃窃私语，神色间透着几分古怪。

    春桃耳尖，听得真切，瞬间皱起眉头：“这些人在乱说什么！居然造谣说小姐掌家之后心狠抠门，刻意克扣各院月例，连下人份例都层层压榨，比从前柳姨娘管事的时候苛刻百倍！”

    沈清鸢眸色微冷，指尖的银匙轻轻磕在瓷碗边，发出一声轻响。

    果然来了。

    柳氏不敢明面与她抗衡，便想用最卑劣的法子，散播流言蜚语，败坏她在府中下人的口碑。一旦下人人心浮动、私下怨怼，久而久之，人人都会觉得她苛待下人、刻薄寡恩，哪怕手握管家权，也落得一身坏名声。

    “不用急着去训斥。”沈清鸢起身，理了理衣衫裙摆，“越是急着辩解，越容易落人口实。咱们去前院账房，当众对账。”

    她心里早已猜到源头。能煽动府中底层下人、拿捏月例份例发放的，只有后厨兼管杂项的刘管事。这人是柳氏一手提拔的死忠亲信，往年靠着柳氏包庇，在府中捞了不少好处，也是柳氏如今留在府中最得力的暗线。

    二人快步去往外院账房。

    此刻账房外已经围了不少管事、仆役，人心惶惶。刘管事正站在人群中央，唉声叹气，故意高声诉苦：“诸位也别怪我，如今府中大权在大小姐手里，新规矩下来，月例减半、份例缩减，我也是按规矩办事，实在为难啊！”

    一番话，直接把所有矛盾全都引到了沈清鸢身上。

    一众下人纷纷面露怨言，低声抱怨不停。

    就在群情汹汹之际，沈清鸢缓步走来。

    喧闹的人群瞬间安静下来，所有人下意识垂首站定，不敢再言语半句。

    刘管事心底一慌，随即强装镇定，躬身行礼：“大小姐。”

    沈清鸢目光淡淡扫过众人，最终落在刘管事身上，声音清亮，字字清晰：“刘管事方才说，是我下令缩减所有人月例份例？”

    刘管事硬着头皮点头：“回大小姐，近日份例发放确实减半，府中人人皆知，老奴只是如实告知众人。”

    “好一个如实告知。”沈清鸢唇角勾起一抹冷弧，转身示意账房先生，“把近三日的管家调令、份例账目、我的亲笔签批全部取来，当众念给大家听。”

    账房先生不敢耽搁，立刻翻出卷宗，高声诵读。
content_en:
As the sun gets stronger in the afternoon, the begonias in the courtyard have fallen red all over the ground. When the wind blows, the fine petals fall on the bluestone steps.

Shen Qingyuan carefully put away the secret list of the East Palace sent by Xiao Yuci, folded it neatly and put it into the secret compartment of the makeup box.With this list, she knew all the forces that Xiao Jingyu was hiding in secret, and she no longer had to be passively vigilant.

Chuntao came in with iced lotus seed soup, her eyebrows relaxed: "Miss, it's hot, drink some soup to relieve the heat. Now that we have evidence and control of the family, the Liu family has been banned, the prince has been thought about, and we can finally be stable for a few days."

Shen Qingyuan picked up the silver spoon and gently stirred the soup, shaking his head lightly: "It's not stable. The Liu family has been rooted in the Prime Minister's Mansion for more than ten years, and her cronies are everywhere. She can never sit still and wait for death. Now that she is banned from the hospital, she can't touch me on the surface, and she will definitely make small moves in the dark."

As soon as he finished speaking, there were faint discussions outside the courtyard. Several maids and servants sweeping the floor gathered together and whispered in lowered voices, with a bit of weird expressions on their faces.

Chuntao listened clearly, and instantly frowned: "What are these people talking about! They actually spread rumors that the young lady was ruthless and stingy after becoming the head of the house, deliberately deducting the monthly regulations of each hospital, and even squeezing the servants' status at every level. She is a hundred times harsher than when Aunt Liu was in charge!"

Shen Qingyuan's eyes were slightly cold, and the silver spoon on his fingertips gently hit the edge of the porcelain bowl, making a soft sound.

Sure enough, it came.

Mrs. Liu did not dare to confront her openly, so she wanted to use the most despicable method to spread rumors and ruin her reputation among the servants in the house.Once the servants' hearts are disturbed and they have private resentments, over time, everyone will think that she treats them harshly and is mean and unkind. Even if she holds the power of the housekeeper, she will have a bad reputation.

"There's no need to rush to reprimand." Shen Qingyuan stood up and straightened his clothes and skirts. "The more eager you are to defend, the easier it will be to follow the truth. Let's go to the accounting room in the front yard and reconcile the accounts in public."

She had already guessed the source.The only person who can motivate the lower-level servants in the government and figure out monthly distributions is Manager Liu, who is also responsible for the kitchen and miscellaneous matters.This person is a loyal confidant of the Liu family. In the past years, he relied on the Liu family's protection to gain a lot of benefits in the mansion. He is also the Liu family's most powerful secret agent in the mansion now.

The two of them quickly went to the accounting room in the outer courtyard.

At this moment, many stewards and servants had gathered outside the accounting room, and people were panicking.Manager Liu was standing in the middle of the crowd, sighing and complaining loudly: "Don't blame me, everyone. Now the power in the house is in the hands of the eldest lady. With the new rules, the monthly quota has been halved and the daily quota has been reduced. I also act according to the rules. It's really embarrassing!"

With these words, all conflicts were directly directed to Shen Qingyuan.

All the servants had complaints on their faces and kept complaining in low voices.

Just as the crowd was in turmoil, Shen Qingyuan walked slowly over.

The noisy crowd suddenly fell silent. Everyone subconsciously lowered their heads and stood still, not daring to say another word.

Manager Liu panicked, then pretended to be calm, bowed and saluted: "Miss."

Shen Qingyuan's eyes swept over everyone, and finally fell on Manager Liu. His voice was clear and his words were clear: "Manager Liu just said, was it me who ordered the reduction of everyone's monthly salary?"

Manager Liu nodded bravely: "Back to the eldest lady, the distribution of quotas has indeed been reduced by half recently. Everyone in the house knows it, but I just told everyone the truth."

"It's good to tell the truth." Shen Qingyuan raised a cold arc at the corner of his lips, turned around and motioned to the accountant, "Get all the housekeeper's transfer orders, division of accounts, and my signature for the past three days, and read them to everyone in public."

The accountant didn't dare to delay, so he immediately took out the file and read it loudly.
